messages:
Maya Lin: Quick notice 1: vendor approval threshold updated to $5k annual spend, effective immediately.
Aaron Briggs: Does this include renewals that roll the spend over the $5k mark?
Priya Nair: Yes. Renewals that push a vendor above $5k need a PO + vendor risk check.
Aaron Briggs: Card purchases below $500 still ok?
Priya Nair: Correct. Under $500 via corp card. $5009k needs PO request + manager sign-off.
Maya Lin: Emergency purchases: two manager approvals + finance email sign-off, log in #procurement-emergencies.
FinanceBot: Reminder set: "Vendor approvals update" will ping the finance channel tomorrow at 09:00.
Aaron Briggs: Thanks, will update my team's procurement doc.
Priya Nair: Ping me if you need the PO snippet or form link.
